title: Method
intro: One shared collection. Different views for different tasks.

stages.title: Select
stages.body: Public research and institutional accounts with a reported gain and an identifiable AI role. Marketing claims alone do not qualify.

stages.title: Check
stages.body: Trace claims to source passages. Distinguish comparisons from reported episodes. Source checks do not independently verify events.

stages.title: Follow
stages.body: Keep review dates and published versions. Add corrections, later findings, and contrary evidence to the record and its history.

scope: Benefits only, measured in their own terms, without a universal grade. Inclusion does not establish prevalence, net benefit, or overall endorsement.
review: Prepared through AI-assisted source review and editorial selection.
reuse: Tailor the view. Keep the same records, sources, limits, and saved versions. Original sources retain their own terms.

foundations.title: ESMO Magnitude of Clinical Benefit Scale
